findings.title: Query parameter interpolated directly into SQL string
findings.description: src/routes/admin.js:17 builds the WHERE clause by concatenating req.query.q into the SQL text. The fragment after LIKE '% is caller-determined, so the statement shape is not fixed at author time.
findings.suggested_action: Bind q as a query parameter rather than concatenating it into the statement text.

findings.title: Pooled DB connection is never released on the error path
findings.description: src/routes/admin.js:16 awaits db.query inside the handler with no try/finally. If the query rejects, the rejection propagates out of the handler and the pooled connection is not returned, so repeated failures exhaust the pool.
findings.suggested_action: Wrap the query in try/finally and release in finally, or use the pool's managed-query helper.

code_corrections.issue: The new route is registered below the other route declarations, separated from them by a blank line, so the registrations are no longer grouped.
code_corrections.fix: Group the new route with the existing router.get registrations above module.exports.
